name: spacecrate_story_signup_1
description: Travel to <destination> where you'll pick up raw materials and join a merchant fleet. This is a 5 part storyline.

values: Travel to <destination> where you'll pick up raw materials and join a merchant fleet. This is a 5 part storyline.

children.key: While wiping bugs of your windshield a SpaceCrate official approaches you with a brisk walk "Good day!" he shouts up at you, "It has come to our attention that you've gained quite the reputation with SpaceCrate Inc. as a reliable courier.
As such I've been authorized by CEO Arnan de Gans himself to recommend you for a position in our organization. Would you be interested in working for SpaceCrate Inc. on a more regular basis?
We'll do a trial of a few missions first. At the end of the trial you'll be awarded 1 million credits for your efforts if you accept the position."
"No thanks. I've got other things to do."
"All right!" the official says, "Excellent! I like your enthusiasm. My name's John Curtain." "<first> <last>" you say."
"You should be aware that you need a large vessel with a cargo hold of 450 tons at least for this first job. I'm assuming you have such a vessel available?"

"As you know we from SpaceCrate are all about exporting goods. To do so we need raw materials." the official says, "I am John Curtain. Currently I am putting together a sizable fleet to collect a shipment of raw materials." "I'm <first>" you say, "Where is the fleet going? And when? Any risk?"
John replies "Always a risk... Although a small one. You'll get an escort from our Defense Force." he says nodding, "Everyone will be waiting at your destination."
"The trip will be fairly short, 6 or 7 jumps from here. You'll leave as soon as you're able. But bear in mind you'll need a cargo hold of at least 450 tons."
"I'm sorry you aren't able to help. But, if you're back in the area soon, stop back in and perhaps you can join the next convoy."

values: You accepted the SpaceCrate offer to possibly work for them.
You land at the spaceport and a message pops onto your comlog "This is port control. Please wait in the spaceport lounge while we load the shipment."
The first part of the SpaceCrate Recruitment Program went well and you're ready to continue.
You have failed an essential part of the SpaceCrate Recruitment Program. Please re-apply in 6 months.

"Ok! We can leave in a couple of minutes."
"I have some other things to do first."
"There are 2 large Hauler and 4 Container Transports." he says, "your protection is provided by 8 Berserkers. Good luck out there!"

No thanks. I'm going to head out on my own.

children.key: John meets you in the Spaceport the next day and introduces Justine, a timid looking woman, as the newly recruited manager.

"Justine is the new Banana Straightening plant manager." John says with a smile, "But on one condition, remember?" Justine quickly interjects. "We have to go to Pearl to pick up some of my personal things.""
Shrugs. We'll leave in a minute!
I've got other things to do. Cya!

Looking at the few boxes in the cargo hold you wonder what could have taken them so long...

values: You're headed back and finish your SpaceCrate Recruitment Program trial.

children.key: John steps into the cockpit as you land. "I'm impressed with your work." He says. "I've taken the liberty of signing you on as a SpaceCrate Inc. Logistics Courier."
"The main perks are that you'll be authorized for larger shipments and on top of that you'll get a salary of $20k a day." John continues.
"As our business continues to expand more jobs and assignments may become available in the future. So welcome aboard, and good luck with your endeavors!!"
"Clearance for the new jobs will take a day or so to process but I trust you'll find them on the Job Board soon enough!" And with that John walks off, leaving you alone.

name: spacecrate_story_goosechase_1
description: CEO Arnan looks like he lost something valuable. Help him find it by whatever means... This is a 4 part side-story.

values: CEO Arnan looks like he lost something valuable. Help him find it by whatever means... This is a 4 part side-story.

children.key: As you land and wait for the ship caterer to finally restock the pantry with doughnuts you notice a man wandering around your ship.
Curious what the guy is doing you approach him and ask, "What are you doing here? Anything I can help you with?"
The man looks up and you recognize him as CEO Arnan de Gans, he looks at you for a second and sighs deeply.
"I'm looking for the hood ornament of my ship" He exclaims, "A silver goose, if it's not here it probably got stolen on <planet>."
"If you manage to find it I'll reward you handsomely <first>."
You decide to leave the CEO alone.

values: When you land a message shows onto your comlog "Pilot <last>? This is port control. A CEO Arnan from SpaceCrate sent word that you might find the culprit in the Spaceport"
The hood ornament seems impossible to find.

You shout into the port lounge "Where is that guy going?!", met with blank stares you point at the small ship flying away while reaching for your gun.
Considering your options for a few seconds you...
Decide to do something else first.

values: The wild goose chase takes you to <destination>.

The hood ornament seems more difficult to find than you anticipated.

name: spacecrate_story_goosechase_3
description: Capture the thief and retrieve the hood ornament. Requires 1 bunk space.

values: Capture the thief and retrieve the hood ornament. Requires 1 bunk space.

children.key: Inside the ship you find its pilot hiding in a cupboard. Taking no chances you hold the door closed and demand to know where the hood ornament is.
"It's on the roof" the pilot replies. "Please don't hurt me..."
Looking on the roof you indeed see some kind of ornament, but it's not a goose.

"Where is the Goose ornament?" You ask the locked in pilot. "Some guy on <destination> took it" The pilot says. You knock out the pilot and lock him in a storage compartment on your ship. Finally you report his ship for smuggling pineapples to Trove.

values: The wild goose chase takes you to the pirate planet named <destination>.
"As you land on <destination> you immediately notice a fighter with a shiny hood ornament. It's shaped like a goose.
The wild goose chase lead you to <destination> where you find a ship with a hood ornament that looks like a goose.
You got close to finding the hood ornament but not quite close enough.

name: spacecrate_story_goosechase_4
description: Return the hood ornament you retrieved from the pirate pilot you found on <origin>. Requires 2 bunk spaces and 1 ton of cargo space.

values: Return the hood ornament you retrieved from the pirate pilot you found on <origin>. Requires 2 bunk spaces and 1 ton of cargo space.

children.key: Entering the spaceport it's full of dodgy looking people.
"Who's ship is that?" You ask gesturing at a blinged out Hawk on a nearby landing pad.
One of the men jumps up and charges at you. A fierce fight ensues but you manage to overpower the guy.
Having captured the Pirate pilot you lock him into a cargo compartment on your ship and load the hood ornament. The other Spaceport guests look none too happy.
Fearing repercussions you quickly enter your ship and just as you take off you see a group of pilots running for their ships.
Try to outrun the pirates to <destination>.
I've got other things to do first.

values: After arresting both thieves and retrieving the hood ornament you've upset several pirates.

CEO Arnan is waiting for you at the landing pad with a security team and a forklift. He arrests both men and has them taken away. Then the forklift unloads the Goose Hood Ornament. CEO Arnan is very pleased with your results and gives you a 'finders fee' along with a $5000/day pay raise.
The wild goose chase is concluded.
You got close to retrieving the hood ornament but failed to complete all tasks.
